音译: transliteration (rendering phonetic value, e.g. of English words in Chinese characters); characters giving phonetic value of Chinese word or name (when the correct characters may be unknown); transcription (linguistics); to transcribe phonetic symbols
音读: reading or phonetic value of a character; (Japanese linguistics) on-reading, a pronunciation of a kanji derived from its pronunciation in a Sinitic language at the time it was imported from China (Note: An on-reading of a character is distinguished from its kun-reading(s) 訓讀|训读[xun4 du2]. For example, 山 has an on-reading "san" and a kun-reading "yama".)
音轨: sound track; track number (e.g. on a CD)
音长: sound duration; length of a musical note
音韵: music; rhyme and rhythm; initial, 音[yin1], and final and tone, 韻|韵[yun4], of a Chinese character; phoneme
音韵学: Chinese phonetics (concerned also with rhyme in poetry)
音响: sound; acoustics; audio; hi-fi system; stereo sound system (abbr. for 組合音響|组合音响[zu3 he2 yin1 xiang3])
音频: audio; sound; audio frequency; sound frequency
驳: variegated; heterogeneous; to refute; to contradict
驳倒: to refute; to demolish (an argument, theory etc)
驳回: to reject; to turn down; to overrule
驳岸: a low stone wall built along the water's edge to protect an embankment; revetment
驳斥: to refute; to debunk; to deny; to denounce
驳落: to peel off; mottled; to fail an exam; to be demoted
驳词: a refutation (variant of 駁辭|驳辞[bo2 ci2])
驳议: to correct (in writing) sb's errors or misconceptions
驳面子: to hurt sb's feelings by rebuffing their request
鹳嘴翡翠: (bird species of China) stork-billed kingfisher (Pelargopsis capensis)
